exact.MIDI-Kanal (am SQ: Utility › General › M: MIDI channel (on the SQ: Utility › General › MIDI)
exact.Der Test prüft nur, ob das Pult antworte: The test only checks whether the console answers (port 51326). It saves nothing and does not disturb any MIDI connection.
exact.Natives Protokoll (Port 51326): Namen, F: Native protocol (port 51326): names, colours, meters, selection, SOLO, gain/EQ/gate/comp/FX. Does not disturb the Stream Deck plugin.
exact.MIDI mitbenutzen (Fader, Mute, Pan, Szen: Use MIDI as well (faders, mute, pan, scenes)
exact.MIDI-Verbindung – nur einschalten, wenn: MIDI connection – only switch on when the Stream Deck plugin is off. Without MIDI, faders/mute show “NO MIDI”.
exact.Alle Patch-Versionen der getesteten Firm: Allow all patch versions of the tested firmware
exact.„Follow SQ Channel Select“ und „Follow S: switch on “Follow SQ Channel Select” and “Follow SQ Mix Select” – MixPad then follows the selection on the console and the X-Touch.
exact.MIDI-Eingang (Name oder Teil davon): MIDI input (name or part of it)
exact.Mackie-Modus: beim Einschalten SELECT vo: Mackie mode: hold SELECT of channel 1 while switching on. Display brightness there with knob 8 (50 % reads well), save with SELECT 1.
exact.SELECT am X-Touch setzt die Auswahl am P: SELECT on the X-Touch sets the selection on the console
exact.Nur Eingänge auf der sichtbaren Pult-Ebe: Only inputs on the visible console layer (otherwise “DESK LAYER”). MixPad follows.
exact.Fader berühren wählt den Kanal: Touching a fader selects the channel
exact.FX-Returns: Pegel des FX-Sends anzeigen: FX returns: show the level of the FX send
exact.Das Pult liefert keinen Return-Meter (wi: The console provides no return meter (as in the Stream Deck plugin).
exact.DCA: Pegel der Mitglieder zusammenfassen: DCA: combine the levels of the members
exact.USER wechselt reihum User 1 → 2 → 3 → 4: USER cycles User 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 (SHIFT + USER backwards), display U1–U4. 8 slots = 8 faders; “empty” leaves the strip dark.
exact.X-Touch – Taste anklicken zum Belegen: X-Touch – click a key to assign it
exact.Taste in der Zeichnung anklicken. Graue: Click a key in the drawing. Grey keys are free, a blue dot = has a SHIFT assignment. SHIFT, CONTROL, ALT and SAVE are fixed.
exact.Eigene Namen (erscheinen auf den Tasten,: Own names (shown on the keys, e.g. “Talkback”). SoftKeys need “Use MIDI as well”.
exact.REC-Tasten der Kanalzüge: REC keys of the channel strips
exact.Die App erkennt den Effekt je Slot selbs: The app detects the effect in each slot itself (from the console state). Only set it by hand here if it is “unknown”.
exact.Keine Befehle ans Pult, nur Anzeige und: No commands to the console, display and meters only.
exact.Fader, MUTE, SOLO, SELECT bleiben immer: Faders, MUTE, SOLO, SELECT always operate the channels.
exact.Regler: REC schaltet die Funktion des Re: Knobs: REC steps the function of the knob above the strip (input: Gain → Pan → HPF → Trim, otherwise pan), push knob = default value. The lower display line shows the function, briefly the value while turning, briefly the dB while moving the fader.
exact.Modus-Taste (TRACK, PAN, EQ, PLUG-IN, IN: Mode key (TRACK, PAN, EQ, PLUG-IN, INST): on – again = next block – then back to Mix. CANCEL = Mix at once.
exact.SHIFT = fein, CONTROL + Regler drücken =: SHIFT = fine, CONTROL + push knob = default value, ALT = unlock.
exact.INPUTS, AUDIO TRACKS (FX-Returns), AUDIO: INPUTS, AUDIO TRACKS (FX returns), AUDIO INST (DCA), AUX, BUSES (groups), OUTPUTS (matrix/LR), MIDI TRACKS (FX sends), USER (user layers 1–4).
exact.BANK ◀▶ = 8 Kanäle, CHANNEL ◀▶ / Jog = A: BANK ◀▶ = 8 channels, CHANNEL ◀▶ / jog = selection by 1.
exact.Einstellungen › Tastenbelegung: Taste an: Settings › Key assignment: click a key, choose a function (normal and with SHIFT) – also SQ SoftKeys, Tap Tempo, mute groups, direct scene.
exact.F1–F8 (SHIFT = 2. Belegung) wählen einen: F1–F8 (SHIFT = 2nd assignment) choose a bus: faders = send level, master = bus, knob = send pan, push = pre/post.
exact.Szene: ▲▼ vormerken, ENTER zweimal oder: Scene: ▲▼ to preselect, ENTER twice or ALT + ENTER.
exact.Aufnahme: ALT + RECORD 1 s. 48V: TRACK,: Recording: ALT + RECORD 1 s. 48V: TRACK, select channel, ALT + GROUP 1 s.
exact.Sel am Pult → X-Touch springt mit. SELEC: Sel on the console → the X-Touch follows. SELECT on the X-Touch (inputs) → console and MixPad follow if the input is on the visible console layer.
The SQ allows only one MIDI connection. If the Stream Deck plugin is running, switch off “Use MIDI as well” (faders/mute then on the Stream Deck) or quit Stream Deck.
exact.Am X-Touch: beim Einschalten SELECT 1 ha: On the X-Touch: hold SELECT 1 while switching on, knob 8 = brightness (50 %), save with SELECT 1.
exact.aus – frei für das Stream-Deck-Plugin: off – free for the Stream Deck plugin
exact.Gerät einschalten (Mackie-Modus) und per: Switch the device on (Mackie mode) and connect it via USB.
exact.Keine Antwort – IP-Adresse prüfen und ob: No answer – check the IP address and whether the computer and the SQ are on the same network.
exact.Verbindung abgelehnt – stimmt die IP-Adr: Connection refused – is the IP address right? The console must be switched on and on the network.
exact.Gerät nicht erreichbar – Mac und SQ im s: Device not reachable – are the computer and the SQ on the same network (192.168.7.x)?
Please enter the IP address first.
exact.Vorgemerkte Szene laden (zweimal drücken: Load preselected scene (press twice or ALT)
exact.Tap Tempo – tippen setzt das Tempo am Pu: Tap Tempo – tapping sets the console tempo, the key flashes in time
exact.EQ: HPF an/aus, TRACK: Pad an/aus: EQ: HPF on/off, TRACK: pad on/off
exact.EQ: alle Gains auf 0 dB (mit ALT): EQ: all gains to 0 dB (with ALT)
exact.48V des gewählten Eingangs (TRACK, ALT +: 48V of the selected input (TRACK, ALT + 1 s)
exact.SHIFT = fein, CONTROL + Drücken = Standa: SHIFT = fine, CONTROL + push = default value
exact.TRIM + ALT = alle EQ-Gains 0 dB: TRIM + ALT = all EQ gains 0 dB
exact.EQ nochmal = zurück zu Mix, Cursor ◀ = E: EQ again = back to Mix, cursor ◀ = E1
exact.Fader = Sendpegel, Master = Pegel des We: Faders = send level, master = bus level
exact.gleiche F-Taste oder SEND = Sends aus: same F key or SEND = sends off
exact.Modi: Gain/Trim, Pan, EQ, Gate/Comp, FX: Modes: Gain/Trim, Pan, EQ, Gate/Comp, FX
exact.Regler drücken = nächste Funktion (Gain: Push knob = next function (Gain → Pan → FX1–4)
exact.Display unten: Funktion, beim Drehen kur: Lower display: function, briefly the value while turning, briefly the dB on the fader
exact.Übungsmodell mit Beispielwerten – klicke: Practice model with sample values – click keys in the picture (TRACK, PAN, EQ, SEND, PLUG-IN, INST, F1–F8, SHIFT, CANCEL) and REC or SELECT of a channel strip. The real device is shown live on the dashboard.
exact.Regler drücken = Standardwert bzw. umsch: Push knob = default value or toggle
exact.Gelb leuchtend = Taste aktiv. Unter jede: Lit yellow = key active. Below each knob: ↓ = what pushing does. The meter LEDs below the displays always follow the channel level.
exact.Schema des großen X-Touch mit acht Kanal: Diagram of the full-size X-Touch with eight channel strips, master fader and key sections
exact.Gain der 8 Kanäle (ohne Gain: Pan): Gain of the 8 channels (without gain: pan)
exact.Modus-Taste wählen: TRACK, PAN, EQ, PLUG: Choose a mode key: TRACK, PAN, EQ, PLUG-IN, INST
exact.▲▼ Szene vormerken, ENTER×2 oder ALT+ENT: ▲▼ preselect scene, ENTER×2 or ALT+ENTER load
exact.Jeder Kanal in seiner Kanalfarbe: Each channel in its channel colour
exact.MUTE = Kanal-Mute (Send an/aus gibt es i: MUTE = channel mute (send on/off does not exist in the protocol)
exact.F-Tasten sind in den Einstellungen frei: F keys are freely assignable in the settings
exact.F-Taste nochmal oder SEND = zurück zu Mi: F key again or SEND = back to Mix
exact.Regler 1–4 = Gain (LF, LMF, HMF, HF), Re: Knobs 1–4 = gain (LF, LMF, HMF, HF), knobs 5–8 = frequency
exact.READ = EQ an/aus, WRITE = HPF an/aus: READ = EQ on/off, WRITE = HPF on/off
exact.SELECT an einem anderen Kanal = EQ des n: SELECT on another channel = EQ of the new channel
exact.EQ nochmal = Block E2 (Güte und Hochpass: EQ again = block E2 (Q and high-pass)
exact.Regler 1–4 = Güte (Q) der Bänder, Regler: Knobs 1–4 = Q of the bands, knob 5 = high-pass frequency
exact.Schwelle, Tiefe, Attack, Hold, Release,: Threshold, depth, attack, hold, release, key filter
exact.Schwelle, Ratio, Attack, Release, Knee,: Threshold, ratio, attack, release, knee, gain
exact.Effekt je Slot wird vom Pult erkannt: The effect in each slot is detected from the console
exact.INST nochmal = nächster FX, Cursor ◀ ▶ =: INST again = next FX, cursor ◀ ▶ = parameter page
exact.Schema, nicht maßstabsgetreu. Tasten geh: Diagram, not to scale. Keys follow the original X-Touch layout.
Normally one assignment applies to all strips. For a channel type only change what should differ there (“as All” takes over). By default REC steps the function of the knob above the strip.
This channel type has no knob function.
exact.Reglerfunktion dieses Zuges weiter: Next knob function of this strip
exact.Reglerfunktion dieses Zuges zurück: Previous knob function of this strip
exact.REC = Reglerfunktion dieses Zuges weiter: REC = next knob function of this strip (SHIFT + REC back)
exact.Vorige Reglerseite (EQ E1/E2, Gate/Comp,: Previous knob page (EQ E1/E2, gate/comp, FX parameter page)
exact.Nächste Reglerseite (EQ E1/E2, Gate/Comp: Next knob page (EQ E1/E2, gate/comp, FX parameter page)
exact.Zurück zur normalen Reglerfunktion (Mix): Back to the normal knob function (Mix); discards a preselected scene
exact.Vorgemerkte Szene laden: zweimal drücken: Load preselected scene: press twice or hold ALT + press
exact.Gewählter Kanal: EQ, Gate oder Comp an/a: Selected channel: EQ, gate or comp on/off – whichever the knobs currently show (only in EQ and gate/comp)
exact.Gewählter Kanal: im EQ der Hochpass an/a: Selected channel: in EQ the high-pass on/off, in TRACK the pad on/off
exact.Gewählter Kanal: alle EQ-Bänder auf 0 dB: Selected channel: all EQ bands to 0 dB – only in EQ, hold ALT + press
exact.Gewählter Eingang: 48V an/aus – nur in T: Selected input: 48V on/off – only in TRACK, hold ALT + press for 1 s
exact.Untere Displayzeile: Kanalnummer (IN 1 …: Lower display line: channel number (IN 1 …) instead of function – again = back
exact.Große Anzeige wechseln: Auswahl → Szene: Switch the large display: selection → scene → time
exact.Halten: Regler fein, Tasten mit 2. Beleg: Hold: fine knob steps, keys with 2nd assignment
exact.Halten + Regler drücken = Standardwert,: Hold + push knob = default value, + touch fader = 0 dB
exact.Halten = Freigabe für Szene laden, Aufna: Hold = unlock for load scene, recording, 48V, EQ flat
exact.Absichtlich ohne Funktion (Schutz vor Sp: Deliberately without function (protects against storing on the console)
Click a key in the drawing.
exact.Übungsmodell mit Beispielwerten: Taste a: Practice model with sample values: click a key to see what it does. Knobs: turn with the mouse wheel, click = push. The real device is shown live on the dashboard.
exact.Mausrad = drehen, Klick = drücken (Stand: Mouse wheel = turn, click = push (default value)
exact.Kanaltasten: Einstellungen › Tastenbeleg: Channel keys: Settings › Key assignment › Channel keys
exact.Eine Vorlage enthält Tastenbelegung, Kan: A template contains key assignment, channel keys, knob functions, user layers, SoftKey names and behaviour – not the connection to console and X-Touch.
exact.Name der neuen Vorlage, z. B. Gottesdien: Name of the new template, e.g. Sunday service
exact.Name: Name
exact.Vorlage laden? Die aktuelle Belegung wir: Load template? The current assignment will be replaced (connection stays).
exact.Tap Tempo setzt das Tempo direkt am Pult: Tap Tempo sets the tempo directly on the console over the network; the key flashes in time. Only without a network connection a SoftKey is triggered instead:
Click the version number at the top left.
exact.Die Brücke läuft bereits (Port 7077 ist: The bridge is already running (port 7077 is in use) – e.g. as a background service or in another window. Please quit it first.
